sections.heading: Welcome aboard Borealis
sections.body: Independent Elevor360D passenger guide for guests sailing aboard Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines’ Borealis. This guide is not affiliated with Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines.

sections.heading: Official ship information and deck plans
sections.body:
Official Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines Borealis information, deck plans and facilities: https://www.fredolsencruises.com/our-ships/borealis

Internet access is required.

sections.heading: Finding your cabin
sections.body: Use the official deck plan or your booking information to confirm your cabin, deck, nearest lifts and muster information. The in-app cabin finder is a personal note-taking aid, not an official deck directory.

sections.heading: Dining
sections.body: Borealis offers a selection of restaurants and dining experiences. Check your onboard daily information for current restaurant names, opening times, booking arrangements and any additional charges.

sections.heading: Bars and lounges
sections.body: Use the Bars & Dining section to record favourite venues, opening hours and notes. Consult the current ship guide for the full list of lounges and bars.

sections.heading: Entertainment and activities
sections.body: Entertainment, talks, activities and performances vary by sailing. Refer to the ship’s daily programme for times and locations.

sections.heading: Facilities and wellness
sections.body: Use the Facilities section to save details of pools, wellness areas, lifts and other amenities. Check the official ship guide for current facilities and accessibility information.

sections.heading: Ship highlights
sections.body: Borealis is part of the Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines fleet. This app helps you organise your cruise plans, spending, packing, favourites and port visits in one place.

sections.heading: Before travelling
sections.body: Check your passport, entry requirements, travel insurance, luggage labels, embarkation instructions and the cruise line’s latest guidance.

sections.heading: First day onboard
sections.body: Locate your cabin, review safety and muster instructions, check your dining arrangements and read the daily programme.

sections.heading: Ports and excursions
sections.body: Record port plans, excursion meeting points and the ship’s official all-aboard time. Always confirm times onboard.

sections.heading: Offline and privacy
sections.body: Your personal notes are stored locally on your device. External ship links require internet access. This app is not connected to onboard accounts.

sections.heading: Disclaimer
sections.body: Independent unofficial guide, not endorsed by or affiliated with Fred. Olsen Cruise Lines. Ship details, venues, deck plans and prices can change; verify onboard.
